method: Read the complete three-file diff and adjacent fixed-policy reconstruction, control-update verifier and proxy transaction journal/recovery paths. Independently inspected actual targeted JSON results and the real Xray harness destination receiver, ClientHello/Host construction, isolated network setup, routing configuration and child cleanup. No successful test was rerun.
checks: New preparation replaces visible HTTP/TLS destinations and uses AsIs. The real pinned core emits the sniffed domain rather than the erroneous original public IP; removing only routeOnly is insufficient, as the IPIfNonMatch control concretely misroutes a synthetic China DNS answer.

Exact selected configuration SHA and full canonical document reconstruction remain mandatory. Only the new whole policy and the unique prior whole policy are accepted; arbitrary listeners, rules, mixed or asymmetric sniff settings remain rejected.

Old/new journals validate both immutable generations. Actual isolated-root file/Manager verification tests cover old-to-new on the same core, rollback and interrupted selected recovery to both targets. Core update alone intentionally does not regenerate proxy policy.

Existing cgroup/nft/private bypass and VLESS credential import are unchanged. The isolated real-core experiment confirms bigmodel/geosite-China and literal private/China direct controls; no current host routing or service selection was changed.

The deployment guide and architecture distinguish HTTP CONNECT readiness from actual transparent/account acceptance, mention private bypass and old-policy rollback behavior, and accurately describe candidate recovery scope.
limits: Real Xray means its installed pinned core and geodata ran in a loopback-only namespace; VLESS receiver and DNS mappings were controlled substitutes, not a commercial provider acceptance.
The fixture uses a fixed original destination, not production nft SO_ORIGINAL_DST. Private DNS answers bypassed before the real transparent listener remain outside this repair.
Current 120 still has the old selected policy until deployment. Actual worker TLS, native account/model directory and public browser checks remain required after the full-suite gate.
No model inference, real external MCP task, credential refresh, source mutation or production restart was performed by this independent review.
